# `mise uninstall`

- **Usage:** `mise uninstall [FLAGS] [INSTALLED_TOOL@VERSION]…`
- **Effect:** destructive — may delete or irreversibly overwrite
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/uninstall.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/uninstall.rs)

Remove installed tool versions

Removes installed versions but does not edit mise.toml. Use `mise unuse` to
remove a tool from mise.toml and uninstall it. A tool name or version prefix,
such as `node` or `node@22`, must match exactly one installed version unless
you pass `--all`.

`--local` removes the installed versions that the project's own config files
request. Installs are shared by every project, so other projects that use the
same versions have to install them again.

## Arguments
- **`[INSTALLED_TOOL@VERSION]…`** — Tools to remove, such as node@22.0.0

## Flags
- **`-a --all`** — Remove every installed version of the named tools, or of every tool when none is named
- **`--local`** — Remove the installed versions the nearest project config requests

  The project is the nearest directory, starting at the current one and moving up, that has a mise config file. Every config file in that directory counts, such as `mise.toml`, `mise.local.toml`, `conf.d` fragments, `.tool-versions` and idiomatic version files. Configs in parent directories and global or system configs do not. Lists what it will remove and asks for confirmation unless `--yes` or a dry run is given.
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show what would change without changing anything
- **`--dry-run-code`** — Like --dry-run, but exit with code 1 if there are tools to uninstall

  Use it in scripts that check whether tools need uninstalling.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Uninstall a specific version

```
mise uninstall node@22.0.0
```

Uninstall node when exactly one version is installed

```
mise uninstall node
```

Uninstall every installed version of node

```
mise uninstall --all node
```

Preview the versions this project's config requests

```
mise uninstall --local --dry-run
```
